[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

此美化需要安装[url=https://smapi.io/] SMAPI[/url] 。

以及需要两个前置模组，[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]以及[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]。


安装方法：

首先下载解压安装Portraiture模组，将该模组拉进星露谷mod文件夹，点开Portraiture文件夹，再点开Portraits文件夹，将下载并解压好的ScarletJsc's Potraits直接放进Portraits文件夹中。

This mod requires SMAPI to be installed.

It also requires two prerequisite mods: Portraiture and Content Patcher.

Installation Instructions:

First, download and extract the Portraiture mod, then drag it into the Stardew Valley mods folder. Open the Portraiture folder, then open the Portraits folder, and place the downloaded and extracted ScarletJsc's Portraits directly into the Portraits folder.
